scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic proof and two independent checkers are included. The scientific review is not independent scholarly certification.
scientific_limitations: This theorem treats only minimum [1,2]-dominating sets of rook graphs with both dimensions at least three; the numerical minimum and the two-row example are prior art. Finite verification does not replace the general proof. Potential unindexed historical priority remains unresolved.
title: A mobility threshold for minimum two-quasiperfect domination on rook graphs
